build_task_template: build a phyre task template that places jars on angled bars with a target ball
create_bar_from_point_angle: create a static bar from a point and angle with optional length constraints
create_bar_between_points: create a static bar connecting two coordinate points in the scene

review_build_task: review the build_task function to understand jar placement and spatial relationship logic
